root_cause_hypothesis: PASS after two TOOL_DEFECTs were found and FIXED in this session (both blocked the grounded path for a date-effective table): (1) neither create(properties.indexes[]) nor add-index could set ValidTimeStateKey/ValidTimeStateMode, and modify-property rejects BonusRateIdx.ValidTimeStateKey as an unknown AxTable property — fixed by a TS post-write (directXmlSetIndexValidTimeState) wired into both create and add-index; NoGap proved to be the SDK default (a bridge round-trip dropped <ValidTimeStateMode>NoGap</…>; shipped indexes only ever spell out Gap), so NoGap removes the element and Gap writes it. (2) add-field fieldType=FromDate wrote i:type=AxTableFieldString → xppc "Data type mismatch" on ValidFrom/ValidTo; the resolver handed the bridge the ROOT EDT NAME (TransDate) because the index records no primitive for root EDTs — fixed by using create's ladder (bridgeEdtBaseType → resolveEdtBaseType → heuristicEdtBaseType); re-adding the fields through the fixed tool produced AxTableFieldDate. Also: modify-property PrimaryIndex="" wrote an empty <PrimaryIndex></PrimaryIndex> (BPErrorTableNoPrimaryIndex) — a third post-write (directXmlClearEmptyProperty) removes the empty element, after which the table has the surrogate-key primary index like every shipped date-effective table (HcmPositionDetail) and xppbp is down to DeveloperDocumentation + FormRef warnings. Platform facts: no ValidFromDate/ValidToDate EDTs exist on 10.0.x — FromDate/ToDate (Date, ApplicationPlatform) were used; the valid-time-state key index must list WorkerId + ValidFrom + ValidTo.
